title: Ashbury Rewards Guidance on the Welcome Stay-Frequency Supplement
content:
Frequent guests receive a stay-frequency supplement with their Ashbury Rewards welcome points.

## Rule

A member whose account shows ten or more stay night-credit transactions posted in the twelve months before the handling date carries a welcome stay-frequency supplement of five hundred points, five to nine such transactions carry two hundred and fifty points, and fewer carry none. The supplement forms part of the welcome points of the stay; when the tier's welcome amount for the stay is zero, the stay receives no welcome points and carries no supplement.

The transactions counted are the night-credit transactions posted for stays — one per credited stay — and not the co-brand card anniversary night credits. The twelve months before the handling date are the transactions posted after the same day number twelve months earlier, up to and including the handling date.

| Stay night-credit transactions in the twelve months | Supplement |
|---|---|
| 10 or more | 500 points |
| 5 to 9 | 250 points |
| 4 or fewer | None |

## Cases (hypothetical accounts)

| Stay night-credit transactions in the window | Card anniversary night credits in the window | Supplement |
|---|---|---|
| 9 | 1 | 250 points |
| 10 | 0 | 500 points |
| 4 | 1 | None |
| 5 | 0 | 250 points |
